diff_summary.review_summary: The corrected dispatch exposes the exact artifact. Architecture adjudication defers the detailed baseline exposure payload to G2 only as a strict limitation, but the missing full reward causal identity and non-durable handling of duplicate-conflicting rewards directly violate G1 provenance and quarantine requirements. G1 remains blocked.

findings.evidence: G1 explicitly owns versioned reward provenance and fail-closed causal joins. The reward API and the event schema at shared/schema.ts lines 276-293 have no caseId or rewardVersion, while assertSameRun at lines 202-206 checks only runId. Action, authorization, outcome, reward, and credit transitions can append input experimentId/experimentVersion without matching them to predecessors. This cannot be deferred to G2 because ADR line 66 and the M1 outcome require accepted reward to join the same experimentId/runId/decisionId/caseId/rewardVersion before M1 completes.
findings.required_fix: Required architecture fix remains, but this review does not authorize implementation: represent and enforce caseId and rewardVersion plus experiment identity across every causal transition, with composite uniqueness and negative identity tests.
findings.title: Full reward causal identity remains a required G1 implementation defect

findings.evidence: G1 objective explicitly includes quarantine, and ADR line 67 requires duplicate-conflicting or malformed rewards to produce rejection/quarantine events. Lines 364-370 throw DUPLICATE_REWARD_JOIN before appending any event, while storage.ts lines 555-560 make terminal rewardId/outcomeId unique across accepted and quarantined rows. The invalid attempt can therefore leave no immutable audit event. Preventing credit is necessary but does not satisfy the required provenance/quarantine contract.
findings.required_fix: Required architecture fix remains, but this review does not authorize implementation: model a separate immutable reward-attempt rejection/quarantine identity that records conflicts without weakening the single accepted causal join, and test durability plus non-creditability.
findings.title: Non-durable duplicate-conflict handling remains a required G1 quarantine defect

findings.evidence: The current G1 decision/action payload stores only context, selectedAction, action, and offline sideEffectMode. ADR line 64 describes the eventual complete action record, but the canonical gate map assigns auditable proposed/delivered exposure and propensity to M2/ALAYA-V2-G2, whose objective explicitly owns proposed/delivered exposure and renderer/request digests. G1 does prove the narrower success criterion that an offline action commit is durable before authorization. The scaffold is therefore acceptable only as a non-evidence-bearing G1 substrate and cannot support any Gate 3+ exposure claim.
findings.required_fix: NONE_FOR_G1. Preserve this limitation through assurance: G2 must freeze and validate the complete ordered candidates, constraints, policy/checkpoint, proposed/delivered action, propensity, renderer, and request digests before any baseline, replay, OPE, provider, or readiness claim.
findings.title: Detailed action and exposure provenance is a G2-bounded limitation rather than a G1 blocker

next_action: Controller should ACK and RECORD_REVIEW for this exact REVIEW_NEEDS_REPAIR, preserve the G2-bounded action-provenance limitation, and hold for an explicit human/control-plane decision. Do not activate M2, dispatch a repair, call a provider, or expand the claim boundary.
risks_or_blockers: G1 cannot close because accepted reward identity is not bound to caseId and rewardVersion and later transitions can carry a mismatched experiment version.
Duplicate-conflicting reward attempts can terminate as exceptions without immutable quarantine evidence, contrary to the G1 quarantine objective and ADR invariant.

The current action payload is only a G1 ledger scaffold; it must not be used as baseline exposure, propensity, replay, OPE, provider, or scientific evidence until G2 freezes the full proposed/delivered exposure contract.
All passing tests remain local-check evidence and do not override the two missing contract guarantees.
This architecture review authorizes no second Worker repair, redispatch, repair-budget expansion, or product mutation.
